_note: Re-baselined 2026-07-31 at the close of the Castalia completion campaign. These are regression ceilings, not targets: they exist to catch growth nobody decided on. The previous numbers were set against the pre-campaign app, which had no refraction pass, no scene cue director, no Attunement, no reading surfaces and no citations. Attempted and rejected before raising them: drei deep imports saved 92 bytes, so Rollup was already tree-shaking the barrel, and code splitting does not help because these metrics measure total JavaScript rather than the initial chunk. Raising a ceiling to fit deliberate, reviewed work is legitimate; raising one to fit an accident is not, so any future increase should carry the same kind of note.
